brief: 5 content tools that quietly replaced a $5K/month creator agency.

slots.desc1: All-in-one workspace for planning content calendars and writing scripts.
slots.desc2: Design social posts, decks and brand assets in minutes.
slots.desc3: Edit video by deleting text like a Google Doc.
slots.desc4: Research, ideate and draft copy in your brand voice.
slots.desc5: Queue posts across every channel from one dashboard.

slots.toolTagline: The command center for every piece of content you publish.
slots.bigStatement: Replaces your content calendar, script bank and client wiki with one database.
slots.use1Body: Map out a month of posts, hooks and CTAs in one board.
slots.use2Body: Draft long-form captions and video scripts inside the same page.
slots.use3Body: Manage sponsorships, deadlines and assets without a single spreadsheet.

slots.toolTagline: Design studio that turns non-designers into polished brand builders overnight.
slots.bigStatement: Drop your brand kit in once, then resize campaigns for every platform instantly.
slots.use1Body: Build ten-slide LinkedIn carousels using locked grids and auto-spacing.
slots.use2Body: Magic Switch turns one design into Stories, Reels and banners.
slots.use3Body: Lock fonts and colors so freelancers never stray off-brand again.

slots.toolTagline: A video editor that works exactly like a Google Doc.
slots.bigStatement: Cut filler words, add captions and publish to YouTube without touching a timeline.
slots.use1Body: Delete a sentence in the transcript and the video follows automatically.
slots.use2Body: Generate 99% accurate subtitles in 20 languages in seconds.
slots.use3Body: Remove echo and background noise with one toggle.

slots.toolTagline: Your 24/7 research assistant, copy editor and headline lab rolled into one.
slots.bigStatement: Turn a half-formed idea into a full outline, hook and SEO title before lunch.
slots.use1Body: Generate twenty scroll-stopping openers and pick the highest-impact angle.
slots.use2Body: Turn a blog post into a Twitter thread and newsletter instantly.
slots.use3Body: Rewrite any paragraph to sound bold, warm or deadpan in seconds.

slots.toolTagline: The quiet engine that publishes while you sleep or build.
slots.bigStatement: Queue a month of content in one sitting, then let it auto-post everywhere.
slots.use1Body: Drop posts into a calendar that publishes to five platforms automatically.
slots.use2Body: See which hooks drive clicks without exporting data to Sheets.
slots.use3Body: Resurface top-performing posts when your audience is most active.

slots.toolTagline: Long-form sales copy and ad variants written from a single prompt.
slots.bigStatement: Produce landing pages, emails and ad sets in your exact brand voice at scale.
slots.use1Body: Generate complete long-form copy with headers, bullets and CTAs instantly.
slots.use2Body: Spin up ten Facebook hooks to test angles without writer's block.
slots.use3Body: Train the model on your tone so every output sounds like you.

slots.body: This lean stack handles strategy, design, editing, writing and distribution. Start with one, add the rest free.
